caption:
The video captures a still, wide view of a calm lake at twilight, where a pastel sky fades from orange at the horizon to violet overhead. Two pale pink contrails rise through this glow, forming a shallow V. A dark pine-covered island anchors the right side, a low silhouetted treeline runs along the left horizon, and a thin band of mist hovers above the glassy water. A small boat and a floating platform with a ladder appear motionless in the middle distance, while lily pads and reed stems cluster in the foreground.

Across the foreground water, faint concentric ripples spread slowly outward from a small dark object, their rings softening as they travel. The dark triangular foreground object holds fixed along the bottom edge. The island, treeline and dock keep their positions throughout, while the contrails and mist change only slightly. The sky glow remains essentially constant. The small dark object at the ripple source appears to stay near the center as the expanding rings fade toward the lily pads.
